recommendation.label: INFERENCE
recommendation.text: RULED: option A. The binding stage today is the environment, not the edge: the machine crashed twice on 10-28, delivered 17 of 24 hours of tape and then none for 13 hours, and the crash damage stopped the journal and the readout. The reversible half is done this morning: tape restored, corruption quarantined, loaders made tolerant so the next crash heals itself. The edge finding of 10-28 stands and cannot advance until the tape runs three clean held-out days; the operator holds options B and C, which decide how many hours of tape a day the operation gets.
